title: ML Assignment Report: English-to-Hindi Legal Text Translation

objective.summary: Prototype a translation system for Indian court judgments with lightweight adaptation and separate tokenizer-efficiency analysis.

dataset.source: Local corpus of 30 English-Hindi judgment pairs
preprocessing: Wrapped-line cleanup, legal paragraph splitting, and sequence-aware alignment
dataset.alignment_note: English and Hindi records are aligned with sequence-aware paragraph-number matching after wrapped-line cleanup. Block-order fallback is used only when the cleaned paragraph blocks already line up safely.
